patch.value: isEnvironmentInvalidated reports an edit for an environment that is absent, and the fence regex is duplicated five times

CodeRabbit review of pm-rl#12, Minor plus Trivial.

isEnvironmentInvalidated returns a boolean true for four distinct conditions - missing affected_version, missing fence, hash mismatch, and any thrown error from getTypedItem - and buildLineageAncestry renders one fixed reason, environment was edited, for all four. A test registers a generation whose environment_version resolves to nothing and asserts the row reads environment was edited. The environment was never edited; it is absent. The operator is given a wrong diagnosis of a provenance failure. LineageRow.invalidated is already typed string-or-null, so return the reason rather than a boolean.

Separately the specification fence regex is written out five times in index.ts, so every copy must change together. Define it once.

Confirmed while reviewing: the OpenGrep command-injection.exec-js findings on those lines are FALSE POSITIVES - each call is RegExp.prototype.exec, not child_process.exec.
